description.zh: 鉴权有效时间，单位秒。只有在您开启了CDN配置中的鉴权功能时有效。
description.en: Authentication validity duration, in seconds. This parameter takes effect only when you have enabled the authentication feature in Alibaba Cloud CDN configuration.

description.zh:
要查询的文件的ID/URL。
支持同时查询多个文件，多个文件ID使用半角逗号（,）分隔。最多可以设置50个文件ID/文件URL。
description.en:
ID or URL of the file(s) to query.  
You can query multiple files simultaneously by separating their IDs or URLs with commas (,). You can specify up to 50 file IDs or URLs.

description.zh:
文件列表模式，可选值为：
- DEFAULT（默认） ：默认模式，所有文件按照上传时间倒序展示。
- DIRECTORY：文件夹模式。
description.en:
File list pattern. Valid values:  
- DEFAULT (default): Default pattern. All files are displayed in descending order by upload time.  
- DIRECTORY: Folder pattern.

description.zh:
用来标记当前开始读取的位置。置空表示从头开始。
>仅商业版支持该功能
description.en:
Used to mark the position from which reading starts. An empty value indicates reading from the beginning.  
> This feature is supported only in the commercial edition.
Number of entries per page. Default Value is 10.

description.zh: 路径前缀。默认查询根目录。
description.en: Path prefix. By default, queries the root directory.
